_readme: The name of every chat, so 'the second tennis one' is never a question
anyone has to answer from memory six weeks later.
Hand-edited. Every run of dictator.bat compares it against WORKSTREAMS in
scan.py and reports anything in one list and not the other. The two are
NOT merged, because they answer different questions: WORKSTREAMS says
which folders belong to which workstream; this says what each chat is
called and what to type in it. Comparing catches drift. It does not
prevent it -- the fee formula reached 17 copies while its rule was a
name     what a human calls it. Unique. Shown everywhere.
slug     the short code. Must match the mailbox folder and BRIEF section.
folders  the folders this chat is allowed to work in.
purpose  one plain sentence. What this chat is FOR.
opening  the exact words to type in that window on a normal day.
subjects what this chat is ABOUT, in words an idea might use. Used to
route a new idea. Add words here rather than tuning code.
created  the date the chat was named.

chats.name: TENNIS
chats.purpose: Tennis paper test - 16 bots, no money.

chats.purpose: Baseball paper test - 16 bots, no money. Runs the sizing experiment.

chats.purpose: This window. Reports, routes ideas, does no project work.

chats.opening: you are the reopen chat, check your mail

chats.name: THE DESK
chats.purpose: The baseball window you look at. Shows the bet; you place it.
chats.opening: you are the livedesk chat, check your mail
